title: Control Consistency Losses for Diffusion Bridges
abstract: arXiv:2512.05070v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Simulating the conditioned dynamics of diffusion processes, given their initial and terminal states, is an important but challenging problem in the sciences. The difficulty is particularly pronounced for rare events, for which the unconditioned dynamics rarely reach the terminal state. In this work, we propose a novel approach for learning diffusion bridges based on a self-consistency property of the optimal control. The resulting algorithm learns the conditioned dynamics in an iterative online manner, and exhibits strong performance in a range of empirical settings without requiring differentiation through simulated trajectories. Beyond the diffusion bridge setting, we draw connections between our self-consistency framework and recent advances in the wider stochastic optimal control literature.

translated_title: 扩散桥的控制一致性损失
translated_abstract: 在给定初始状态和终端状态的条件下，模拟扩散过程的条件动力学是科学领域一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。对于稀有事件而言，这一困难尤为突出，因为无条件动力学很少能到达终端状态。在这项工作中，我们基于最优控制的自洽性（self-consistency）性质，提出了一种学习扩散桥的新方法。由此得到的算法以迭代在线的方式学习条件动力学，在一系列实证场景中表现出色，且无需对模拟轨迹进行微分求导。除了扩散桥这一设定之外，我们还将自洽性框架与更广泛的随机最优控制文献中的最新进展建立了联系。
tldr: 本文基于最优控制的自洽性性质提出了一种学习扩散桥的新方法，以迭代在线方式学习条件动力学，无需对模拟轨迹进行微分即可在多种场景中取得优异表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel approach for learning diffusion bridges based on a self-consistency property of optimal control, learning conditioned dynamics in an iterative online manner without requiring differentiation through simulated trajectories, achieving strong performance across a range of empirical settings.
